name: paris-night-curvy-selfie
image_purpose: Fitness lifestyle post and night-gym moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic but realistic gym mirror selfie at night with a blurred Paris cityscape beyond the windows.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman matching the required character reference, kneeling comfortably on a light-blue exercise mat while looking back toward the mirror and holding a smartphone. She wears a white crop T-shirt and soft pastel-pink athletic shorts with the visible supplied back text/marking from the reference, preserved without inventing new typography.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 wide-angle mirror selfie with the subject slightly turned away, treadmills and bikes softly out of focus, large windows showing blurred night city lights, mirror reflections, and light-blue exercise mat.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused gym lighting from above and left, subtle night-window glow, realistic skin and athletic-fabric texture, cinematic urban fitness atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone wide-angle camera, 3:4, realistic mirror geometry, natural skin pores, fabric seams and machine texture, subtle grain, controlled contrast and no artificial smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic but realistic 3:4 wide-angle gym mirror selfie of one approved adult woman matching the required character reference, kneeling comfortably on a light-blue exercise mat while looking back toward the mirror and holding a smartphone. She wears a white crop T-shirt and soft pastel-pink athletic shorts with the visible supplied back text or marking from the reference preserved without inventing new typography. Include large windows with a blurred Paris cityscape at night, out-of-focus treadmills and bikes, mirror reflections, soft gym lighting from the left and above, realistic skin and fabric texture, subtle grain, and urban fitness lifestyle mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, invented or altered text, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, watermark, low resolution, blur

assets.usage: Preserve approved adult identity, outfit, visible supplied text/marking, safe kneeling pose, gym equipment, city windows, mat, reflection, and lighting.

Equipment and distant city details may be replaced; do not invent or alter text or logos. Any replacement person must be an approved adult.
